title: Take release-manifest mode from the git index so it is the same on every platform
action: Replace the stat-based mode_octal with a git-index derivation (100755 -> 755, anything else -> 644) in devtools/release_manifest.rs, update the header comment documenting the Windows-666 behaviour, and regenerate the committed manifest with bee dev release-manifest --write.
verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml devtools::release_manifest && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: mode no longer reads filesystem permission bits
release-manifest --check green on Linux and identical on Windows
rebuild_reproduces_the_committed_manifest passes with no platform cfg
